items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: We'd come as far as Chicago with the Nat W. Toles band... we actually begged for days to be off

ctx.x: Yeah, always played that. And he was popular out there, you know. And we played all out in Minnesota and Iowa and you know, in Midwest. We'd come as far as Chicago with the Nat W. Toles band and we'd go back to Minnesota and Idaho and Colorado. We played all, you know, like in those places like that. He had that much of a territory and he'd book us all down South and places like that and we actually begged for days to be off and we had a sleeper bus, specially made in Sioux City, Iowa, and they had a -- you know,…
